business_problem: adidas needed a more scalable review-analysis stack because its legacy chatbot was not built for GenAI or RAG, response times were high, and nontechnical users could not easily explore customer sentiment.
solution_summary: adidas uses Databricks AI Search, Databricks BGE Large, Databricks Model Serving, and Unity Catalog to support RAG-based product review analysis and insight generation. adidas needed a more scalable review-analysis stack because its legacy chatbot was not built for GenAI or RAG, response times were high, and nontechnical users could not easily explore customer sentiment. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Databricks AI Search, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks BGE Large, and delivers outputs through Databricks Model Serving. Documents, notes, and knowledge assets are consolidated into Databricks AI Search; Databricks BGE Large applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks Model Serving.
